title: Immunofluorescence Protocol
author: Margaret I. Davis
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kz3cx8n

steps.title: Fix Brain via Perfusion
steps.instruction: Fix the brain using perfusion with 4% freshly prepared and filtered formaldehyde in Phosphate-Buffered Saline (PBS).

substeps.instruction: Rinse vasculature first with 37°C PBS.
Perfuse with 4% formaldehyde.
Post-fix overnight (maximum 12 hours) in ~10 volumes of 4% formaldehyde at 4°C.
Wash for at least 1 hour in PBS before sectioning.

steps.title: Vibratome Sectioning
steps.instruction: Section the brain at 40 µm using a vibratome and collect sections in PBS within a 24-well culture plate.

substeps.instruction: Treadmill after 6 wells back to the first well (typically 180-200 coronal sections from olfactory bulbs to nigra).
If cutting past nigra/VTA (e.g., locus coeruleus), cut the brain in half or use a cryostat.
Optional: Use 2% agarose for support, but ensure it is removed as it may bind antibodies.

steps.title: Section Storage
steps.instruction: Store sections in PBS at 4°C until ready for use.

substeps.instruction: Ideally use within a few days; otherwise, freeze in cryoprotectant or store at 4°C with 0.01% sodium azide in PBS.
Wrap in foil if brains contain fluorescent protein or tracers.

steps.title: Sample Selection and Preparation
steps.instruction: Select columns to stain and transfer them into PBS in the staining well using paintbrushes.

substeps.instruction: Typical loading is 25-30 sections per well in ~500 µL (24-well plate) or combine columns in 12-well trays (~800 µL).

steps.title: Optional Autofluorescence Quenching
steps.instruction: If tissue has been stored for longer than ~1 month, quench autofluorescence using sodium borohydride.

substeps.instruction: Incubate 2 x 5 min with 5 mg/mL NaBH4 in water.
Wash twice with PBS.

steps.title: Permeabilization
steps.instruction: Permeabilize the tissue by replacing PBS with PBST (0.2% Triton X-100).

substeps.instruction: Incubate for at least 1 hour.
Use a pipet tip attached to a plastic transfer pipet to remove solutions; avoid touching tissue with suction.

steps.title: Blocking
steps.instruction: Block the sections using 5% Bovine Serum Albumin (BSA) prepared in PBST.

substeps.instruction: Use 500 µL/well in a 24-well tray.
Incubate for 4 hours to overnight; overnight incubations must be on an orbital shaker in the cold.
Optional: If BSA is insufficient, block with 0.5% serum + 5% BSA from the species of the secondary antibody (e.g., goat or donkey).

steps.title: Primary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Replace BSA solution with primary antibody prepared in PBST (e.g., chicken anti-GFP, 1:2000 or 0.5 µL/mL).

substeps.instruction: Incubate overnight to 72 hours at 4°C on an orbital shaker.

steps.title: Primary Antibody Wash
steps.instruction: Wash sections at least 3 x 30 minutes with PBST on an orbital shaker at room temperature.

steps.title: Secondary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Add species-appropriate Alexa-conjugated secondary antibody diluted in PBST.

substeps.instruction: Incubate overnight at 4°C on an orbital shaker.
Wrap in foil to protect from light after adding antibodies.
Optional: Add DAPI (1:20,000 of 5 mg/mL stock; 0.5 µL into 10 mL PBST) during the first wash.
Alternative: Use ToPro-3 (dilute 1:20,000) for far red (647 nm) nuclear staining.

steps.title: Optional Myelin Fluorescence Blocking
steps.instruction: Block myelin fluorescence using Sudan Black.

substeps.instruction: Incubate 2 x 5 mins with filtered 0.1% Sudan Black in 70% EtOH.
Wash once with water, then three times for 15 minutes with PBST.
If destaining is insufficient, increase Triton concentration 2-fold or destain overnight.

steps.title: Mounting
steps.instruction: Mount sections in order from PBS onto Superfrost plus slides.

substeps.instruction: Spread sections with paintbrushes using a few drops of PBS.
Blot excess PBS and allow to dry upright for ~3-5 mins (do not over-dry).
Apply ~3 drops of Fluoromount and seal with Sally Hansen Extreme Wear nail polish.
Use #1.5 coverslips for Zeiss microscopes.

steps.title: Imaging
steps.instruction: Image sections using a microscope system.

substeps.instruction: Image every section on the Axiozoom at low power (11-16x or tiled 100x images).
If signal is not visible at 250x on Axiozoom, check on Axiovert.
Perform high power or tiled imaging (>10x) on a confocal microscope if needed.
Save files in original Zeiss format to preserve metadata.
